g.text: Since the late 1980s world coffee output grew 1.9x on 12% more land. Cocoa grew 2.3x and needed

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #4a4741

g.text: 2.1x the land. 88% of cocoa's extra output came from new farms, against 18% for coffee.
